author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the release window trailer for Moomin: Midsummer Madness, the cozy point-and-click adventure game developed by Crossbridge Game Studios. Players will embark on a new heartfelt journey with the Moomin family as Moominvalley is submerged by a great flood. Uncover the secrets of a mysterious floating theatre full of familiar faces in this charming, hand-painted adventure. Moomin: Midsummer Madness will launch in fall 2026 for PC (Steam), Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Moomin: Midsummer Madness - Official Release Window Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo launch trailer for Thimble Dungeon, a snack-sized auto-battler roguelite game developed by vibedeploy. Pick a path, watch your party work, and pray they reach the stairs. Your heroes do the dying. Bank their souls, delve again. You'll die. You'll get stronger. You'll delve again. Every run is just a few minutes. Thimble Dungeon will be available on PC (Steam). A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Thimble Dungeon - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Selsoviet, an immersive sim developed by Overedge Games. A mother of two runs the only shop in a dying Soviet village in the Russian Far East, 1976. There isn't enough food to go around, and every day you decide who gets something and who goes without. Meanwhile, her own children are gravely ill, and the hospital is impossibly far away. How far are you willing to go to save them? Selsoviet will be available on PC (Steam), with a free demo coming soon.
title: Selsoviet - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Battle for the Planet' Chapter 12 Trailer for Final Fantasy 7: Ever Crisis, the free-to-play turn-based action-adventure RPG developed by Applibot and Square Enix. Cloud and his companions learn the secrets of Holy (the ultimate white magic). Chapter 12 of Final Fantasy 7: Ever Crisis will be released on August 12 for iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Final Fantasy 7 Ever Crisis - Official Chapter 12 'Battle for the Planet' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo trailer for Brew & Defend, a medieval tavern management game with tower defense mechanics developed by Sketchy Rabbit. Build your supply chain, grow crops, brew beverages, and strategically place taverns along the road to satisfy a parade of thirsty customers before they ruin your reputation! A demo is launching on Steam on August 14, 2026.
title: Brew & Defend - Official Demo Trailer
